say:0:1311101101:0.text: Let's check out what's going on around here!
say:0:1311101101:0.source_cn: 我们快去看看雪松镇的情况！

say:0:1311102001:0.text: Why hasn't everything returned to normal here?
say:0:1311102001:0.source_cn: 这里为什么没有恢复原样！

say:0:1311103001:0.text: The guy who was about to propose has turned into a snowman as well!
say:0:1311103001:0.source_cn: 那个求婚的年轻人也变成雪人了！

say:1:1311103002:0.source_cn: 情况似乎越来越严重了……

say:1:1311104002:0.text: This is so weird, Chippy's little brain can't keep up! Didn't we stop the rituals?
say:1:1311104002:0.source_cn: 可我们明明已经中断了那个仪式……

say:2:1311105001:1.text: Magister, did we forget something important? Why hasn't the time loop ended yet?
say:2:1311105001:1.source_cn: 主人，我们是不是漏掉了什么关键事情没有做啊！为什么时间...
say:2:1311105001:1.male: Magister, did we forget something important? Why hasn't the time loop ended yet?
say:2:1311105001:1.female: Magister, did we forget something important? Why hasn't the time loop ended yet?

say:3:1311105002:1.text: Chippy sees more and more snowmen! Princess Yolena has gone missing too! Could she...
say:3:1311105002:1.source_cn: 小雪人变得越来越多了，连公主殿下也不见了，她该不会也……
say:3:1311105002:1.male: Chippy sees more and more snowmen! Princess Yolena has gone missing too! Could she...
say:3:1311105002:1.female: Chippy sees more and more snowmen! Princess Yolena has gone missing too! Could she...

say:4:1311105003:1.text: I don't see any snowman that looks like Princess Yolena in town... She might be at the ball or back at the castle.
say:4:1311105003:1.source_cn: 镇子里没有看起来像是公主殿下的雪人，或许、或许她去了舞...
say:4:1311105003:1.male: I don't see any snowman that looks like Princess Yolena in town... She might be at the ball or back at the castle.
say:4:1311105003:1.female: I don't see any snowman that looks like Princess Yolena in town... She might be at the ball or back at the castle.

choice_prompt:5:1311105003.text: I don't see any snowman that looks like Princess Yolena in town... She might be at the ball or back at the castle.
choice_prompt:5:1311105003.source_cn: 镇子里没有看起来像是公主殿下的雪人，或许、或许她去了舞会……也可能她已经回城堡了。
choice_prompt:5:1311105003.male: I don't see any snowman that looks like Princess Yolena in town... She might be at the ball or back at the castle.
choice_prompt:5:1311105003.female: I don't see any snowman that looks like Princess Yolena in town... She might be at the ball or back at the castle.

say:6:1311105004:1.text: The magister is right! This is big! We must let the Archduke know!
say:6:1311105004:1.source_cn: 对哦，这里是他的领地，出了这么大的事情，必须告知大公才是。
say:6:1311105004:1.male: The magister is right! This is big! We must let the Archduke know!
say:6:1311105004:1.female: The magister is right! This is big! We must let the Archduke know!

say:7:1311105005:1.text: But we have a deal with Valka, so we should go find her first.
say:7:1311105005:1.source_cn: 不过，我们和瓦丽卡约好了，我们得先去找她。
say:7:1311105005:1.male: But we have a deal with Valka, so we should go find her first.
say:7:1311105005:1.female: But we have a deal with Valka, so we should go find her first.

say:8:1311105007:1.text: Let's hurry and head to the dance venue.
say:8:1311105007:1.source_cn: 那我们赶紧去舞会会场吧。
say:8:1311105007:1.male: Let's hurry and head to the dance venue.
say:8:1311105007:1.female: Let's hurry and head to the dance venue.

choice:5:0:1.text: We need to inform the Archduke.
choice:5:0:1.male: We need to inform the Archduke.
choice:5:0:1.female: We need to inform the Archduke.

say:10:1311105006:1.text: Hopefully, she'll have some new findings.
say:10:1311105006:1.source_cn: 嗯，希望她会有新的发现。
say:10:1311105006:1.male: Hopefully, she'll have some new findings.
say:10:1311105006:1.female: Hopefully, she'll have some new findings.

choice:5:1:2.text: We need to meet up with Valka.
choice:5:1:2.male: We need to meet up with Valka.
choice:5:1:2.female: We need to meet up with Valka.

say:0:1311106001:0.text: The princess isn't here, and there's no snowman of her either.
say:0:1311106001:0.source_cn: 公主殿下也不在，这里也没有她的雪人。

say:3:1311107001:1.text: The state of the hot springs inn has worsened; nearly everyone has turned into a snowman.
say:3:1311107001:1.source_cn: 温泉旅馆变得更糟糕了，几乎所有人都成了雪人。

say:4:1311107002:1.text: The same goes for Cedartown! Those who haven't become snowmen are sounding more lost, and their thoughts are getting increasingly muddled...
say:4:1311107002:1.source_cn: 雪松镇上也一样！那些没有变成雪人的人，说话的时候也比之...

say:5:1311107003:1.text: And Princess Yolena is missing... She was there the last two times we returned.
say:5:1311107003:1.source_cn: 而且，公主殿下不见了……之前两次回来她都还在的。

say:8:1311107005:0.text: You all remember the ball that night, don't you?
say:8:1311107005:0.source_cn: 嗯……你们应该记得那天晚上的舞会吧。

say:9:1311107006:0.text: Of course! Everyone was having a great time until... Oh yeah, you really scared her at the ball!
say:9:1311107006:0.source_cn: 当然记得，大家都很开心，直到……哎呀，我想起来了，舞会...

say:11:1311107011:0.text: I attended the ball to experience, if only briefly, what it might feel like to be truly "alive".
say:11:1311107011:0.source_cn: 其实，我本来只是想来祭典悄悄看看，找到一些“活着”的感觉。

say:12:1311107012:0.text: It was surprising indeed to see Princess Yolena at the opening ceremony... She had no reason to be there.
say:12:1311107012:0.source_cn: 但我在开幕式看到了亚莲娜公主，觉得很不对劲……她不该出...

say:14:1311107014:0.text: A Graveborn acquaintance of mine mentioned that <style="highlight">Princess Yolena succumbed to a grave illness a year ago</style>...
say:14:1311107014:0.source_cn: 我认识一位亡灵，他不久前曾说过，<style=high...

say:16:1311107016:0.text: How is that possible?! She seemed so lively and healthy! She even joined us for the festival. Plus, she doesn't look like a Graveborn at all!
say:16:1311107016:0.source_cn: 可是、可是公主殿下明明那么活泼健康，还和我们一起参加了...

say:17:1311107017:0.text: Valka, how reliable is your source? The princess we saw looked nothing like a Graveborn...
say:17:1311107017:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你的情报来源准确吗……？我们所见的亚莲娜公主，...

say:18:1311107018:0.text: I too harbored doubts, which is why I inquired directly at the ball whether she was truly Princess Yolena. I did not expect her to react so strongly...
say:18:1311107018:0.source_cn: 我也很疑惑，所以我抓住机会，在舞会上问她到底是不是真正...

choice_prompt:19:1311107018.text: I too harbored doubts, which is why I inquired directly at the ball whether she was truly Princess Yolena. I did not expect her to react so strongly...
choice_prompt:19:1311107018.source_cn: 我也很疑惑，所以我抓住机会，在舞会上问她到底是不是真正的亚莲娜公主本人。没想到她的反应那么大……

say:20:1311107019:0.text: Yes, that was my mistake. I shouldn't have asked such a question in that setting.
say:20:1311107019:0.source_cn: ……是的，这是我的失误，我不该在那种场合下贸然发问的。
say:20:1311107019:0.male: Yes, that was my mistake. I shouldn't have asked such a question in that setting.
say:20:1311107019:0.female: Yes, that was my mistake. I shouldn't have asked such a question in that setting.

say:21:1311107020:0.text: I do recall her guard confirming that she had been seriously ill...
say:21:1311107020:0.source_cn: 不过……我记得公主的侍卫说她确实生了一场重病。

say:22:1311107022:0.text: This is super weird... Valka, do you have any proof? Chippy still finds it so hard to believe. We had so much fun playing snowball fights a few days ago...
say:22:1311107022:0.source_cn: 太奇怪了……瓦丽卡，你有什么证据吗？满满还是有点不太相...

say:23:1311107023:1.text: Can you take us to that friend of yours, Valka? Chippy wants to hear them say it for real!
say:23:1311107023:1.source_cn: 对了，你带我们去找你的朋友吧，满满想听他亲口证明这件事！

say:24:1311107024:0.text: Sure. Hopefully he will be able to clear your doubts.
say:24:1311107024:0.source_cn: ……好吧，希望他的话能打消你们的怀疑。

say:26:1311107021:0.text: Exactly, her guard said she was seriously ill, but she's fine now!
say:26:1311107021:0.source_cn: 对，她的侍卫说过她生了重病，但是已经好了！

choice:19:1:2.text: The princess was very ill for a time.
choice:19:1:2.male: The princess was very ill for a time.
choice:19:1:2.female: The princess was very ill for a time.

say:27:1311107007:0.text: Remember how she suddenly screamed in panic while we were dancing?
say:27:1311107007:0.source_cn: 在舞会上，我和她跳舞的时候她突然很惊慌地大叫起来，你们...

say:28:1311107008:0.text: Uh-huh, we all thought you had scared her!
say:28:1311107008:0.source_cn: 嗯，大家都觉得是你吓到了她呢。

choice:7:1:2.text: Your look tells me something's off.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你的表情告诉我事情不简单
choice:7:1:2.male: Your look tells me something's off.
choice:7:1:2.female: Your look tells me something's off.

say:29:1311107009:0.source_cn: 对哦，舞会上你把她吓得不轻……

say:0:1311108001:0.text: By the way, Valka, what's your friend like?
say:0:1311108001:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你那位朋友是什么人？

say:1:1311108002:0.text: He is a noble artist, and he has a rather reserved personality.
say:1:1311108002:0.source_cn: 他是一位贵族艺术家，性格有些清冷。

say:2:1311108003:0.text: Hmm, he sounds like he might be a little tricky to chat with...
say:2:1311108003:0.source_cn: 呃，听起来不太好打交道呢……

say:0:1311109001:0.text: Everything feels so creepy... I can't shake the feeling that something's gonna pop out of the bushes.
say:0:1311109001:0.source_cn: 到处都是阴森森的，总觉得树丛里藏着什么。

say:3:1311110001:1.text: My friend Ludovic lives alone in this Duskmire Forest. He rarely sees anyone and isn't keen on engaging with the outside world.
say:3:1311110001:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔——就是我那位朋友——他独自住在这片黑沼森林中...

say:4:1311110002:1.text: What if he doesn't want to see us?
say:4:1311110002:1.source_cn: 那……我们能见到他吗？要是他不愿意见我们该怎么办？

say:5:1311110003:1.text: Please do not be concerned, I shall present him with a gift.
say:5:1311110003:1.source_cn: 不必担心，我会给他带上一份礼物。

choice_prompt:6:1311110003.text: Please do not be concerned, I shall present him with a gift.
choice_prompt:6:1311110003.source_cn: 不必担心，我会给他带上一份礼物。

say:7:1311110004:1.text: Trust me, I know something he cannot possibly decline.
say:7:1311110004:1.source_cn: 相信我，我知道有一样东西，他是绝对无法拒绝的。

say:9:1311110006:1.text: <style="highlight">Blue spiritroot</style>. It's a rare plant that glimmers with a gentle silver light at night, perfect for making pigments.

say:10:1311110007:1.text: Pigments? Does Ludovic like to paint?
say:10:1311110007:1.source_cn: 颜料？柳博米尔很喜欢画画吗？

say:11:1311110008:1.text: He does. He was renowned throughout the duchy for his exceptional painting skills. He once mentioned that there's a blue spiritroot in this forest, but it would take some effort for him to obtain it alone.
say:11:1311110008:1.source_cn: 嗯，他生前就以高超的画技闻名整个公国。他曾提到过这片森...

say:12:1311110009:1.text: We've got this! With the four of us, we can definitely <style="highlight">get this blue spiritroot</style> to make him happy! Let's go!
say:12:1311110009:1.source_cn: 我们可有四个人呢！嘿嘿，这个礼物一定能让他心满意足的。...

choice:6:1:2.text: We might need a Plan B...
choice:6:1:2.male: We might need a Plan B...
choice:6:1:2.female: We might need a Plan B...

say:0:1311111001:0.source_cn: 看下面，那就是冰蓝灵曼根！

say:1:1311111002:0.text: Oh, that was easy. Something feels off...
say:1:1311111002:0.source_cn: 这么快就发现了？呃，感觉不太对……

say:3:1311112001:1.text: Wow! That was dangerous! If it weren't for Chippy's quick moves, Chippy would've gotten hit! This tree trunk is all rotted out! No wonder it fell so suddenly...
say:3:1311112001:1.source_cn: 哎呀！要不是满满躲得快，就会被砸到脑袋了！这棵树的树干...

say:4:1311112002:1.text: You guys hear that? What kind of animals are making those strange noises? It's so strange...
say:4:1311112002:1.source_cn: 你们听，那是什么动物？叫声好奇怪啊！

say:5:1311112003:1.text: Those are no ordinary creatures; they're hawk moths, native to this forest. They are aggressive toward outsiders who dare to invade their territory.
say:5:1311112003:1.source_cn: 那不是什么动物，是黑沼森林里的一种名叫鹰蛾的怪物，对入...

say:6:1311112004:1.text: *Gasp* Is Ludovic really living in this scary place?
say:6:1311112004:1.source_cn: 啊，原来黑沼森林里这么危险！柳博米尔就住在这种荒凉又可...

say:7:1311112005:1.text: Don't worry about him, hawk moths rarely attack the Graveborn.
say:7:1311112005:1.source_cn: 不必为他担心，鹰蛾很少会攻击亡灵。

say:9:1311112007:1.text: Even the trees here look all twisted and scary... I think we should get out of here quickly.
say:9:1311112007:1.source_cn: 这里的氛围怪怪的，连树都长得很狰狞……我觉得我们还是早...

choice_prompt:10:1311112007.text: Even the trees here look all twisted and scary... I think we should get out of here quickly.
choice_prompt:10:1311112007.source_cn: 这里的氛围怪怪的，连树都长得很狰狞……我觉得我们还是早点离开这里比较好。

say:11:1311112008:1.text: Alright, here comes Sir Chippy! Stand back while Chippy chops through this tree in a flash!
say:11:1311112008:1.source_cn: 没错，区区一棵枯树，满满就可以把它劈开！
say:11:1311112008:1.male: Alright, here comes Sir Chippy! Stand back while Chippy chops through this tree in a flash!
say:11:1311112008:1.female: Alright, here comes Sir Chippy! Stand back while Chippy chops through this tree in a flash!

say:12:1311112010:1.text: Let Chippy give this tree a little taste of his sword!
say:12:1311112010:1.male: Let Chippy give this tree a little taste of his sword!
say:12:1311112010:1.female: Let Chippy give this tree a little taste of his sword!

say:14:1311112009:1.text: But, Magister... there's just a dead tree! We can easily clear it away and get through!
say:14:1311112009:1.source_cn: 可是，主人……那里只有一棵枯树，只要把它清理掉就可以通行了！
say:14:1311112009:1.male: But, Magister... there's just a dead tree! We can easily clear it away and get through!
say:14:1311112009:1.female: But, Magister... there's just a dead tree! We can easily clear it away and get through!

choice_prompt:15:1311112009.text: But, Magister... there's just a dead tree! We can easily clear it away and get through!
choice_prompt:15:1311112009.source_cn: 可是，主人……那里只有一棵枯树，只要把它清理掉就可以通行了！
choice_prompt:15:1311112009.male: But, Magister... there's just a dead tree! We can easily clear it away and get through!
choice_prompt:15:1311112009.female: But, Magister... there's just a dead tree! We can easily clear it away and get through!

choice:15:0:1.text: I don't think it's that easy...
choice:15:0:1.male: I don't think it's that easy...
choice:15:0:1.female: I don't think it's that easy...

choice:10:1:2.text: How about we take a detour?
choice:10:1:2.male: How about we take a detour?
choice:10:1:2.female: How about we take a detour?

say:3:1311113001:1.text: That's odd... Chippy hit the tree with every swing, but it won't budge at all!
say:3:1311113001:1.source_cn: 奇怪……明明满满每一剑都砍到那棵树了，可是根本砍不断它！

say:4:1311113002:1.text: My spells can't seem to scorch it either...

say:5:1311113003:1.text: Let us seek an alternative route. I recall there being another path nearby that leads to...
say:5:1311113003:1.source_cn: 我们绕路过去吧，我记得这附近还有一条路……那条路通往……

say:7:1311113005:1.text: My memories of this forest are growing rather indistinct all of a sudden...
say:7:1311113005:1.source_cn: 通往……应该有一条路，但我突然想不起来了……对这片森林...

say:8:1311113006:1.text: Wait, what's happening... Even Valka seems to be affected.
say:8:1311113006:1.source_cn: 诶？怎么回事……连瓦丽卡也……

say:9:1311113007:1.text: Perhaps this forest has been influenced by the situation in Cedartown. I have not experienced anything like this previously.
say:9:1311113007:1.source_cn: 或许这片森林也因为雪松镇的事情而变得不正常了，我之前从...

say:10:1311113008:1.text: Is it possible that the aftereffects of the time loop are impacting this area? We have to hurry and fix this!
say:10:1311113008:1.source_cn: 难道时间循环的余波影响到了这里？那我们更要快点解决这件...

say:11:1311113009:1.text: I really hope I'm mistaken. For the time being, let us proceed and discover where this path may lead.
say:11:1311113009:1.source_cn: 我倒是希望我说错了，现在走一步看一步吧。我们沿这边走下...

say:0:1311114001:0.text: Do we really have to find this blue spiritroot...?
say:0:1311114001:0.source_cn: 这颗冰蓝灵曼根是非找不可吗……

say:1:1311114002:0.text: Since we made it here, we might as well go find it...

say:2:1311114003:0.text: Besides, Ludovic lives around here, we're bound to pass through here.
say:2:1311114003:0.source_cn: 而且柳博米尔就住在附近，我们总会经过这里的！

say:0:1311115001:0.text: That beast snatched the blue spiritroot!
say:0:1311115001:0.source_cn: 那个怪物拿走了那颗冰蓝灵曼根！

say:1:1311115002:0.text: It... it must have done it on purpose!

say:3:1311116001:1.text: We clearly injured that monster, but how can it still fly so fast? Magister, should we go back the way we came...?
say:3:1311116001:1.source_cn: 这只怪物，明明我们打伤了它，可它怎么还能飞那么快？主人...
say:3:1311116001:1.male: We clearly injured that monster, but how can it still fly so fast? Magister, should we go back the way we came...?
say:3:1311116001:1.female: We clearly injured that monster, but how can it still fly so fast? Magister, should we go back the way we came...?

say:4:1311116002:1.text: Wait, where did we even come from? Why can't Chippy remember anything?!
say:4:1311116002:1.source_cn: 咦？我们刚才是走哪里过来的？满满想不起来了！
say:4:1311116002:1.male: Wait, where did we even come from? Why can't Chippy remember anything?!
say:4:1311116002:1.female: Wait, where did we even come from? Why can't Chippy remember anything?!

say:5:1311116003:1.text: Chippy, what's the matter? We came from that direction... but where exactly...? Wait, I'm feeling all fuzzy too...
say:5:1311116003:1.source_cn: 满满你怎么了？我们是从那边……从哪里……呀，我怎么也迷...

choice_prompt:6:1311116003.text: Chippy, what's the matter? We came from that direction... but where exactly...? Wait, I'm feeling all fuzzy too...
choice_prompt:6:1311116003.source_cn: 满满你怎么了？我们是从那边……从哪里……呀，我怎么也迷迷糊糊的了……

say:7:1311116004:1.text: It appears that the hawk moth has the capacity to influence our nerves and senses from a distance, potentially through the release of a toxin...
say:7:1311116004:1.source_cn: 看来鹰蛾能够远距离影响到我们的神经和感官，也许是依靠某...

say:8:1311116007:1.text: No wonder Ludovic said it would be difficult to obtain the blue spiritroot alone... We must find that hawk moth!
say:8:1311116007:1.source_cn: 那只鹰蛾很危险，怪不得柳博米尔说他一个人很难拿到冰蓝灵...

say:9:1311116008:1.text: But where did it fly off to? Chippy's mind is still all muddled... A-choo! A-choo!
say:9:1311116008:1.source_cn: 可是它不知道飞到哪里去了，满满的脑子现在还是迷迷糊糊的...

say:10:1311116009:1.text: Argh, what was that? Chippy's nose is itchy all of a sudden!
say:10:1311116009:1.source_cn: ……阿嚏……什么东西……满满感觉鼻子痒痒的！

say:11:1311116010:1.text: These are... scales? They must have fallen from the wings of the hawk moth.
say:11:1311116010:1.source_cn: 这是……鳞粉？应该是从鹰蛾翅膀上落下来的。

say:12:1311116011:1.text: I see it now. It uses its scales to manipulate our senses, creating illusions. What we struck just moments ago was likely not the real hawk moth.
say:12:1311116011:1.source_cn: 我知道了，它靠鳞粉来影响我们的感官，让我们产生幻觉！刚...

choice_prompt:13:1311116011.text: I see it now. It uses its scales to manipulate our senses, creating illusions. What we struck just moments ago was likely not the real hawk moth.
choice_prompt:13:1311116011.source_cn: 我知道了，它靠鳞粉来影响我们的感官，让我们产生幻觉！刚才我们攻击的应该并不是真正的鹰蛾。

say:14:1311116012:1.text: So it was its scales that muddled our minds and left us disoriented...
say:14:1311116012:1.source_cn: 原来是它的鳞粉影响了我们的感官，让我们头脑混乱……

say:15:1311116014:1.text: Illusion? This means Chippy still got his wits about him! Uh, let's follow the scales and hunt down that pesky hawk moth! Ah-choo!
say:15:1311116014:1.source_cn: 幻觉？满满就说自己没那么迷糊……唔，那我们也可以沿着鳞...

say:16:1311116015:1.text: We will not be fooled by its illusions again. Let's find that hawk moth!
say:16:1311116015:1.source_cn: 嗯，这样应该不会再被它的幻觉误导。我就不信我们抓不住它！

choice:13:0:1.text: No wonder we've lost our way.
choice:13:0:1.male: No wonder we've lost our way.
choice:13:0:1.female: No wonder we've lost our way.

say:18:1311116013:1.text: Indeed, and that tree falling was too coincidental.
say:18:1311116013:1.source_cn: 的确，刚才那棵树倒下的时机太巧合了！

choice:6:0:1.text: The hawk moth is messing with us.
choice:6:0:1.male: The hawk moth is messing with us.
choice:6:0:1.female: The hawk moth is messing with us.

say:19:1311116005:1.text: But Chippy feels perfectly fine! Chippy's breathing is steady, and these little limbs aren't tingling at all!
say:19:1311116005:1.source_cn: 不对呀，满满没有觉得身体不舒服，呼吸也很顺畅，也没有手...

say:20:1311116006:1.text: Could it be a toxin that's clouding our senses? It feels like our minds are becoming quite muddled.
say:20:1311116006:1.source_cn: 或许是影响感官的毒素……我们的思维都变得混沌了。

say:0:1311117001:0.text: We must find a way to uncover the real hawk moth. Let's head east and see what we can find.
say:0:1311117001:0.source_cn: 得想办法找到那只鹰蛾的真身，我们去东边看看。

say:0:1311118001:0.text: It's gone again! Ugh, this is so frustrating!
say:0:1311118001:0.source_cn: 它又不见了！好烦！还要找多久啊！

say:1:1311118002:0.text: Chippy, don't let it affect your emotions.
say:1:1311118002:0.source_cn: 满满……你的情绪似乎也被影响了。
say:1:1311118002:0.male: Chippy, don't let it affect your emotions.
say:1:1311118002:0.female: Chippy, don't let it affect your emotions.

say:0:1311119001:0.text: There are traces of the scales here. It must have gone this way.
say:0:1311119001:0.source_cn: 这里有鳞粉的痕迹，它往这边走了。

say:0:1311120001:0.text: I can hear it shrieking! It's not far from here!
say:0:1311120001:0.source_cn: 我听到它尖啸的声音了，就在前方不远处！

say:1:1311120002:0.text: We've got to catch it this time!

say:0:1311121001:0.text: The mist has cleared...! We can finally see the path clearly.
say:0:1311121001:0.source_cn: 雾气散去了……！现在能看清道路了。

say:0:1311122001:0.text: Oh, finally... It truly was quite a challenge getting the blue spiritroot!
say:0:1311122001:0.source_cn: 总算拿到了……果然很不容易啊！

say:1:1311122002:0.text: Let's make our way to Ludovic's place.
say:1:1311122002:0.source_cn: 走吧，我们去柳博米尔的宅邸。

say:2:1311122003:0.text: From here, follow the path south, cross through a marsh, and you'll find a place where the everblooms flourish.
say:2:1311122003:0.source_cn: 从这里沿路向南，趟过一片沼泽，直到有永寂花盛开的地方。

say:3:1311122004:0.source_cn: 那就是柳博米尔的居所。

say:0:1311123001:0.text: So Ludovic lives in a mansion deep within the Duskmire Forest?
say:0:1311123001:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔就住在黑沼森林深处的宅邸里？

say:1:1311123002:0.text: In reality, it's just a pile of ruins...
say:1:1311123002:0.source_cn: 宅邸……那里早就是一片废墟了。

say:2:1311123003:0.text: Yet he refuses to leave... After all, that was once his home.
say:2:1311123003:0.source_cn: 不过他舍不得离开……毕竟那曾是他的家。

say:0:1311125001:0.text: What a fun idea to have enchanted furniture as a butler!
say:0:1311125001:0.source_cn: 用附魔的家具来做管家，真有意思！

say:3:1311126002:1.text: Valka, does all the furniture here move?
say:3:1311126002:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，这里所有的家具都会动吗？

say:4:1311126003:1.text: Some pieces do. Ludovic is not very fond of interacting with people, so he enchanted some of his favorite furniture to give them thoughts and the ability to move.
say:4:1311126003:1.source_cn: 有一部分是。柳博米尔不太喜欢和人打交道，所以就给一些他...

say:5:1311126004:1.text: This way, the furniture can take care of this manor for him, making it more like a home.
say:5:1311126004:1.source_cn: 这样，这些家具就可以为他打理这座宅邸，能让这里更像一个家。

say:6:1311126005:1.text: That's super fun! Chippy's gonna have a little chat with them!
say:6:1311126005:1.source_cn: 太有趣了，满满要和这些家具聊聊天！

say:3:1311129001:1.text: Halt! Who gave you permission to enter Everstill Manor? His Lordship rarely receives visitors!
say:3:1311129001:1.source_cn: 你！你们！为何擅闯永寂庄园！子爵先生极少接见外客！

say:4:1311129002:1.text: We were invited in by the candelabra butler. He specifically told us to wait here for Ludovic's arrival.
say:4:1311129002:1.source_cn: 我们没有擅闯，是经过烛台管家允许的。是他让我们在这里等...

say:5:1311129003:1.text: How dare you address His Lordship by name so casually! Such insolence cannot go unpunished!
say:5:1311129003:1.source_cn: 你，竟然直呼子爵先生的姓名！真是无理之人！必须受到惩罚！

say:6:1311129004:1.text: Whoa, calm down! Why are you so angry... and don't just go around and hit people!
say:6:1311129004:1.source_cn: 诶？！你怎么脾气这么暴躁……你怎么打人！

say:2:1311130001:1.text: Please forgive my attendants. They are not accustomed to guests and tend to be excessively vigilant regarding outsiders.
say:2:1311130001:1.source_cn: 请原谅侍者们的失礼。它们很少见外客，对外界过于警惕。

say:3:1311130002:1.text: Your thoughtful gift is truly appreciated and far too precious for me to decline...
say:3:1311130002:1.source_cn: 多谢你们的礼物，它如此贵重……我无法拒绝。

say:4:1311130003:1.text: I sense you have a significant matter to discuss with me.
say:4:1311130003:1.source_cn: 我想，你们一定有必须见我的理由。

choice_prompt:5:1311130003.text: I sense you have a significant matter to discuss with me.
choice_prompt:5:1311130003.source_cn: 我想，你们一定有必须见我的理由。

say:7:1311130004:1.text: You're even younger than Chippy imagined...
say:7:1311130004:1.source_cn: 你比我想象的还要年轻……你、你这么早就成为了亡灵？

say:8:1311130005:1.text: I was underage when I became a Graveborn.
say:8:1311130005:1.source_cn: 是的，成为亡灵的时候我尚未成年。

say:9:1311130009:1.text: Pray tell, what brings you to this secluded manor to seek help from a Graveborn?
say:9:1311130009:1.source_cn: 那么，各位有什么事，需要来到这座偏僻的庄园，找我这样一...

say:11:1311130010:1.text: We wish to confirm the accuracy of your earlier claim that Princess Yolena suffered from a serious illness and has passed away.
say:11:1311130010:1.source_cn: 是关于公国的亚莲娜公主。你曾和我说过，公主身患重病，已...

say:12:1311130011:1.text: Oh, Yolena, that lovely little girl—lovely, yet so pathetic.
say:12:1311130011:1.source_cn: 亚莲娜啊……可爱的小姑娘，可爱，但却可悲。

say:13:1311130012:1.text: Correct. She fell victim to a hereditary condition that proved incurable.
say:13:1311130012:1.source_cn: 没错，她已经死了，死于一种家族遗传的、无法治愈的疾病。

say:15:1311130013:2.source_cn: 什么？！她、她真的已经死了？！

say:17:1311130015:1.text: It was roughly a year ago. Unfortunately, the exact date escapes me.
say:17:1311130015:1.source_cn: 大约在一年前，具体的日子我并不记得。

say:18:1311130016:1.text: Sigmund was in deep despair as though he had lost his soul. He pleaded with every god he could think of to save his daughter.
say:18:1311130016:1.source_cn: 齐格蒙德——她的父亲——绝望得像是失去了灵魂，恳求所有...

say:19:1311130017:1.text: Yet, the gods did not hear his lament.
say:19:1311130017:1.source_cn: 可是，神明听不见他的哭泣。

say:20:1311130018:1.text: With no other options, he sought my help, wishing for me to turn Yolena into a Graveborn. He was willing to do anything to preserve his daughter's life.
say:20:1311130018:1.source_cn: 无奈之下，他来求我，希望我能将亚莲娜转化为亡灵。无论用...

choice_prompt:21:1311130018.text: With no other options, he sought my help, wishing for me to turn Yolena into a Graveborn. He was willing to do anything to preserve his daughter's life.
choice_prompt:21:1311130018.source_cn: 无奈之下，他来求我，希望我能将亚莲娜转化为亡灵。无论用什么方式，他都想要让自己女儿活着。

say:22:1311130019:1.text: So the princess we met was a Graveborn? But she didn't look like one at all...
say:22:1311130019:1.source_cn: 难道和我们一起玩的亚莲娜公主是亡灵？可是……她没有一点...

say:25:1311130023:1.text: Oh, you can't comprehend either? I guess the allure of "being alive" is a temptation few can truly resist.
say:25:1311130023:1.source_cn: 啊……你们也不能理解吗？哈，看来“活着”是大多数人都无...

say:26:1311130024:1.text: Come with me. Let me give you a tour of Everstill Manor.
say:26:1311130024:1.source_cn: 随我来吧，我带你们参观一下永寂庄园。

say:27:1311130025:1.text: Doesn't the duchy's descent into ruin resemble the decaying remains of this manor? How perfectly tragic...
say:27:1311130025:1.source_cn: 走向末路的公国，与这座已经毁灭的宅邸残垣，是多么相称啊……

say:29:1311130026:0.text: Please wait for us, Lord Ludovic!
say:29:1311130026:0.source_cn: 请等等我们，柳博米尔先生……！

say:34:1311130021:1.text: I could sense his despair, but I had to say no.
say:34:1311130021:1.source_cn: 是的。他很绝望，但我还是拒绝了。
say:34:1311130021:1.male: I could sense his despair, but I had to say no.
say:34:1311130021:1.female: I could sense his despair, but I had to say no.

choice:5:1:2.text: I'm glad you like our gift...
choice:5:1:2.male: I'm glad you like our gift...
choice:5:1:2.female: I'm glad you like our gift...

say:37:1311130006:1.text: As friends of Miss Valka, His Lordship would not deny your entry, even without a gift!
say:37:1311130006:1.source_cn: 你们是瓦丽卡女士的朋友，就算没有礼物，高贵的子爵先生也...

say:41:1311130007:1.text: There's no need for such formality, Václav. Everstill Manor has traditionally kept its doors closed to those from outside.
say:41:1311130007:1.source_cn: 不必如此，瓦茨拉夫。永寂庄园就是不欢迎外人。

say:42:1311130008:1.text: Yet I find myself quite fond of the gift presented by these guests. They demonstrate good manners.
say:42:1311130008:1.source_cn: 但是我确实很喜欢这几位客人的礼物。他们是知礼的人。

say:3:1311135001:1.text: Thank you, Your Lordship. Now that we know the truth, it's time for us to get going.
say:3:1311135001:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，柳博米尔先生。既然已经知道了亚莲娜公主的情况，...

say:6:1311135002:1.text: The time loop hasn't ended and the "princess" may cause serious trouble... We must head back and put an end to everything!
say:6:1311135002:1.source_cn: 时间循环没有结束，公主可能有大问题……情况越来越严重了...

say:7:1311135003:1.text: Valka, are you going with them too?
say:7:1311135003:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你也要和他们一起去吗？

say:9:1311135005:1.text: You haven't changed... always trapped in self-doubt and torment, yet unable to let go of your responsibilities...
say:9:1311135005:1.source_cn: 你还是那样，始终在自我怀疑和折磨，却放不下责任……

say:11:1311135007:1.text: The one who resembles Yolena has tainted our family's name.
say:11:1311135007:1.source_cn: 那个顶着亚莲娜面容的人，玷污了我们家族的荣誉。

say:12:1311135008:1.text: Whatever the truth may be, I genuinely hope for your success.
say:12:1311135008:1.source_cn: 无论真相如何，我衷心希望你们一切顺利。

say:13:1311135009:1.text: Let me walk you to the entrance.

say:0:1311136001:0.text: I hope you find out the truth.

say:3:1311137001:1.text: Ludovic, was that the real princess?! Her eyes... She looked like a ghost! Dura above, Chippy is shaking...!
say:3:1311137001:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔，刚才那个真的是公主殿下吗？她的眼睛……她就像...

say:4:1311137002:1.text: Whoever you saw, she is not Yolena.
say:4:1311137002:1.source_cn: 不管那是谁，都不是亚莲娜。

choice_prompt:5:1311137002.text: Whoever you saw, she is not Yolena.
choice_prompt:5:1311137002.source_cn: 不管那是谁，都不是亚莲娜。

say:7:1311137004:1.text: It's nothing. I'm fine... Let's go.

say:9:1311137006:1.text: We must head to the castle. If my guesses are correct, that's where we will find our answer...
say:9:1311137006:1.source_cn: 她……我们……我们得去一趟城堡，如果我猜得没错，一切的...

say:10:1311137007:1.text: It could be very dangerous, you should stay here...
say:10:1311137007:1.source_cn: 那里可能会很危险，你们……留在这里。

say:11:1311137008:1.text: Sir Chippy is braver than you think! After all, it's the thrill of danger that makes an adventure truly exciting!
say:11:1311137008:1.source_cn: 我们才不怕呢！再说了，我们出门就没有不遇到危险的时候！

say:12:1311137009:1.text: In that case... here, take this. It's a map of the Valesa Castle. While it may be a bit worn, it should prove useful to you.
say:12:1311137009:1.source_cn: 既然如此……拿着吧，这是瓦勒沙城堡内部的地图，虽然有些...

say:13:1311137010:1.text: The castle is vast and beautiful. You'll see it for yourself soon enough.
say:13:1311137010:1.source_cn: 瓦勒沙城堡很大，也很美……你们见到的时候就知道了。

say:17:1311137012:1.text: Farewell, everyone. I wish you all the best.
say:17:1311137012:1.source_cn: 再见，各位，希望你们一切顺利。

say:0:1311138001:0.text: Let's go to the castle now! What's wrong, Valka?
say:0:1311138001:0.source_cn: 我们现在就去城堡！诶，瓦丽卡，你怎么了？

say:1:1311138002:0.text: It's nothing. I'm fine... Let's go.

say:6:1311124001:1.text: Excuse me, may I ask who you are and what business you have at Viscount Ludovic's estate? His Lordship dislikes being disturbed without proper arrangement...
say:6:1311124001:1.source_cn: 各位，请留步。请问你们是什么人？为何要前来柳博米尔子爵...

say:7:1311124002:1.text: Hold on, hold on! Did the candelabra just speak?!
say:7:1311124002:1.source_cn: 等等，你先等等！你是个会说话、会动的……烛台？！

say:8:1311124003:1.text: Ah, let me introduce myself! I am Václav, the butler to Viscount Ludovic. It is my duty to manage the daily affairs of Everstill Manor.
say:8:1311124003:1.source_cn: 瓦茨拉夫，为您效劳。我是柳博米尔子爵的管家，负责永寂庄...

say:10:1311124004:1.text: Oh wow, Chippy didn't know Ludovic held such a title!
say:10:1311124004:1.source_cn: 哇，柳博米尔还是一位子爵？

say:11:1311124005:1.text: His Lordship and the former Whiteridge Duke both hail from the Valesa family. The title was bestowed upon him at birth, and the Duke then was his uncle, if I may add.
say:11:1311124005:1.source_cn: 当然！柳博米尔先生与历任白山大公同属瓦勒沙家族，一出生...

say:12:1311124006:1.text: Had it not been for the early demise of His Lordship, he would have succeeded to the title of Earl of Silversparrow from his father. The noble Silversparrow Emblem is a testament to the Valesa family's participation in the First Divine War!
say:12:1311124006:1.source_cn: 如果不是先生早逝，他还会继承来自父亲的银雀伯爵爵位——...

say:13:1311124007:1.text: Oops, I think I may have said too much. How may I assist you today?
say:13:1311124007:1.source_cn: 咳，我说得太多了。诸位客人，你们是……

say:16:1311124008:1.text: Václav, it's me. We've come to see Ludovic regarding an urgent matter.
say:16:1311124008:1.source_cn: 瓦茨拉夫，是我。我们来拜访柳博米尔是有要事相询——很重...

say:17:1311124009:1.text: Ah, Miss Valka! I beg your pardon for my impoliteness, but these guests don't appear to be Graveborn...
say:17:1311124009:1.source_cn: 啊！是瓦丽卡女士，请原谅我的失礼，但这几位并非亡灵……

choice_prompt:19:1311124009.text: Ah, Miss Valka! I beg your pardon for my impoliteness, but these guests don't appear to be Graveborn...
choice_prompt:19:1311124009.source_cn: 啊！是瓦丽卡女士，请原谅我的失礼，但这几位并非亡灵……

say:20:1311124010:1.text: That's right. They are my friends, and they have brought a present for Ludovic.
say:20:1311124010:1.source_cn: 没错，这几位都是很好的人，他们还为柳博米尔带来了一份礼物。

choice_prompt:21:1311124010.text: That's right. They are my friends, and they have brought a present for Ludovic.
choice_prompt:21:1311124010.source_cn: 没错，这几位都是很好的人，他们还为柳博米尔带来了一份礼物。

say:22:1311124013:0.text: Oh, how lovely! This is the blue spiritroot that His Lordship has long desired! With it, the painting he is working on is sure to become a masterpiece!
say:22:1311124013:0.source_cn: 啊，这是子爵先生一直期望获得的冰蓝灵曼根！有了它，子爵...

say:23:1311124014:1.text: Please wait for a moment, I shall inform His Lordship right away.
say:23:1311124014:1.source_cn: 各位，请在前厅稍候，我这就去通报子爵先生。

say:26:1311124011:1.text: These are my friends, and they don't fear us.
say:26:1311124011:1.source_cn: 他们都是朋友，也并不害怕我们。

say:29:1311124012:1.text: Please kindly accept this special gift we've brought for Lord Ludovic!
say:29:1311124012:1.source_cn: 请收下，这是我们给柳博米尔子爵先生特意准备的礼物。

choice:19:1:2.text: We are not against the Graveborn.
choice:19:1:2.male: We are not against the Graveborn.
choice:19:1:2.female: We are not against the Graveborn.

narration:30:13011136:0.text: An odd candelabra blocks your way after you enter the derelict manor.
narration:30:13011136:0.source_cn: 进入庄园废墟后，一个奇怪的烛台拦住了你们。
